buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) SCOPE OF WORK 1.0 The following tests shall be conducted on the TPS-II Expansion Generators as per CERC IEGC Regulations, 2023 (Clause 28(3), 28(4), and 40): 1.1 Real & Reactive Power Capability Assessment 1.2 Reactive Power Control Capability Assessment (as per CEA Connectivity Standards) 1.3 Model Validation & Verification of Generator and Excitation System inclu ding PSS 1.4 Model Validation & Verification of Turbine/Governor and Load Control (Ac tive Power/Frequency Control) and Testing of Governor Performance. 1.5 PSS tuning as per SRPC guidelines. 2.0 All the above tests shall be carried out as per the procedure prescribed by NL DC vide Circular No. NLDC/SO/IEGC/OPERATING PROCEDURE dated 25-10-2023 (Attached in the annexure-1). 3.0 The above tests should be conducted for the BHEL make generator and excita tion system. 3.1 Generator Details: · Make-BHEL · Active Power: 250MW · Voltage: 16.5 KV · Current:10292 A · Apparent Power- 294.1MVA 3.2 Excitation system Details: · Make-BHEL · Static Excitation System

· WBS.No: CE/306-SH1-48-01 and CE/306-SH2-48-01 · DRG.No. 3-653-00-00594 Note: After placing LOA required details will be furnished 4.0 Model simulation and validation for the above tests shall be completed prior t o field testing, and detailed simulation reports shall be submitted before comm encement of on-site tests. 5.0 A detailed test report shall be prepared and submitted for each test in the pre scribed SRLDC/SRPC format within a month form date of completion of tests. Th e work will be completed in all aspects after confirmation of SRLDC/SRPC only ot her wise retesting shall be carried out as per recommendations of SRLDC/SRPC. 6.0 All necessary instruments, tools, software, and equipment required for carryin g out the above activities shall be under the contractor’s scope. ***** 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) File Attachment Click here to view the file. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses SPECIAL CONDITIONS Part-I 1.0 The quoted price shall be firm- 1.1 Towards Model simulation, onsite field test/tuning and submission of test report in accordan ce with SRLDC/SRPC format. 1.2 Charges for travelling expenses (air/train/road) and Accommodation charges shall be paid b y contractor scope. 2.0 The service engineer should bring all the necessary special instruments, tools, and tackles. 3.0 Contractor must come to the site within 48 hours of time after intimation. 4.0 The contractor should adhere to the safety norms, inside the TPS-II Expansion premises. 5.0 The safety of the equipment/components during the maintenance works is the responsibility of the contractor. 6.0 Necessary check list along with the field test report shall be submitted to TPS-II Expansion during e ach visit. 7.0 The work shall be carried out under the supervision of TPS-II Expansion Engineers. 8.0 Detailed service logging with test result shall be furnished to TPS-II Expansion in standard format af ter every visit. 9.0 The equipment's should work properly after the testing. 10.0 GATE ENTRY & SECURITY CONDITIONS: 10.1 The entry into the site is restricted to the workmen with valid pass issued by the CISF. 10.2 The contractor must submit the list of personnel duty approved by NLCIL officials for the subj ect works with a request to issue gate pass before commencing the works. 10.3 Whenever materials are to be taken inside the TPS-II Expansion, the contractor shall submit a list of such items like tools, testing equipment etc., in duplicate to CISF, of which one copy will be retained by CISF, and the other copy authenticated by the NLCIL will be passed on to the c oncerned site-in-charge. Part-II 1.0 SUPERVISOR CHARGES – PENALTY CLAUSE Not Applicable 2.0 Tools & tackles, lifting machines & Safety appliances that are used for the work or by the workmen / Supervisor / Engineer / Technician should posses ISI mark and valid test certificate from the compet ent authority.

3.0 The Contractor should observe all safety rules and regulations in force and ensure that all necessar y safety precautions are followed up strictly for the safety of workmen / Supervisor / Engineer / Tech nician engaged in the work. 4.0 The Contractor should engage adequate man power having appropriate skills with the approval of t he NLCIL officials to carryout and complete the works. Any extra time / over time engagement of the man power shall be the contractor’s responsibility. 5.0 RATE REVISION (NOT APPLICABLE). 6.0 CONTRACT WORKMEN DEATH RELIEF FUND (CWDF) 6.1 An amount equivalent to 0.2% (zero point two percent) of gross value of every bill payable (b efore statutory, non statutory deductions) shall be deducted towards “Contract Workmen Deat h Relief Fund” (CWDF) from the contractors for the works carried out by the contractor. No pro vision has been made in the estimate towards the above deduction. 6.2 Based on the modified DRF scheme, monthly contributions to the death relief fund of Contrac t Workmen / Supervisors shall be deducted by the Contractor Employers concerned @ Rs.25/- from every contract workman / Supervisors engaged by Contractor Employer for the works in NLCIL from their salary /wages payable. In order to facilitate this, necessary deduction will be made from the bills of the Contractor employers based on Form - D (Attendance Register) & Fo rm -B (Wage Register) Equal monthly contribution to the fund @ Rs.25/- per contract workman / Supervisors will be made by the Principal Employer NLCIL i.e. the Concerned Unit Head / Unit Accounts Centre. 7.0 CONTRACT WORKMAN AGE The contractor shall not engage workmen beyond 60 years and the Contractor s hall also produce the required age proof for the workmen engaged by him, while applying for entry permit for first time. 8.0 ESI & EPF The Contractor Employers shall be required to undertake the responsibility of re mitting the contribution/ subscription etc., of the contract workmen / Supervisor / Engineer / Technician engaged by them towards EPF, ESI etc., (as applicable). 9.0 SAFETY Personal protective equipments (PPE) ie like Helmet, Safety shoe, Goggles etc b y to be provided by the contractor and it is in the scope of the contractor. 10.0 PRICE REDUCTION CLAUSE 10.1 FOR SIMULATION & MODELLING: Time is the essence of the contract. In case the contractor fails to complete the works within th e stipulated period (as per Cl.No.13.2.2 & 13.2.3 of Part-II Special Conditions), then, unl ess such a failure is due to Force Majeure or due to Purchaser's defaults, the total contract pric e shall be reduce d by 1/2% (half percent) of the total contract price per week of delay or part thereof subject to a maximum of 5% of the total contract price, by way of reduction in price for delay and not as penalty. 10.2 FOR ONSITE TESTING: Time is the essence of the contract. In case the contractor fails to complete the works within th e stipulated period (as per Cl.No.13.2.1 of Part-II Special Conditions), then, unless such a failure is due to Force Majeure or due to Purchaser's defaults, the total contract price shall be r educe d by 1/2% (half percent) of the total contract price per day of delay or part thereof subje ct to a maxi mum of 5% of the total contract price, by way of reduction in price for delay and n ot as penalty. 11.0 GUARANTEE FOR WARRANTY Not Applicable

12.0 CONTRACT PERFORMANCE GUARANTEE Not Applicable 13.0 PERIOD OF CONTRACT 13.1 24 months from service start date as per GeM contract. Note: Lead days of 7 days are provided to the Service Provider for necessary mobilization for offering service. Thus the service start date will commence from minimum 7 days after contract gener ation date. 13.2 PERIOD OF WORK: 13.2.1 Onsite testing: 7 days for each Generator. 13.2.2 Simulation and modelling period along with submission of report: 3 months from the d ate of GeM order. 13.2.3 Final report submission period: within one month after completion of field tests. 14.0 PAYMENT TERMS 14.1 Payment will be made after completion of each Generator testing and successful submission of field service report, test results etc. and the invoice submitted by the contractor for each tes ting visit and the final bill shall be paid only after finalization of the contract. 14.2 The payment will be released within 45 days after the acceptance of the invoice. 15.0 GST (Goods and Service Tax) Contractor has to furnish the GST Registration number with relevant docume ntary evidence. Contractor has to comply with the GST Act/ Rules. 16.0 NLCIL reserves the right to short close / extend the contract due to special circumstances. 17.0 The General Conditions clauses 12.0 & 35.19 are not applicable. ***** . 4.
